full_judgment: 3. The allegations as disclosed in the said complaint petition is that on 17.4.1998 at 1.00 P.M. the accused persons entered into the Mondir with various deadly weapons; the petitioner being the Sebait of that. Mondir, objected to it, who was beaten by the accused persons on 12.4.1998 for which Bandar P.S. Case Noll dated 17.4.1998 under sections-143/448/325/354 of the Penal Code was started as a result of that case the accused persons again entered' into the Mondir and caused various injury and damaged the properties of the Mondir. The lorned Magistrate made a judicial enquiry dad took cognizance against the accused opposite parties under sections 427/295 of the Penal Code on 30.7.2000.
